# Waveshare ST3215 3D model

`Waveshare-ST3215.step` is the official 3D model of the Waveshare ST3215 serial bus servo, included unmodified so the HX18 assembly opens with the real servo in every joint.

- Source: [Waveshare ST3215 resources](https://docs.waveshare.com/ST3215_Servo/Resources-And-Documents), file [`ST3215-3D.zip`](https://files.waveshare.com/upload/5/59/ST3215-3D.zip)
- SHA-256: `58e38e4dc49f97df738c5f229f9aa8a7dce64a0a1d01335486a52d53e6017e8a`
- The model belongs to Waveshare. It is not covered by this repository's MIT license.
